# T402 Protocol

> Open-source HTTP-native payment protocol for USDT/USDT0 and other stablecoins. Compatible with Tether WDK.

## Overview

T402 is a payment protocol that uses HTTP 402 status codes. Flow: client requests resource -> server responds 402 + PaymentRequirements -> client signs off-chain -> resubmits with signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header -> server verifies via facilitator and serves resource.

Architecture: Transport (HTTP, MCP, A2A) x Scheme (exact, upto, exact-direct) x Network (13 chain families)

**Compatible with [Tether WDK](https://wdk.tether.io)** — bring your own wallet, or use Tether WDK as the underlying wallet layer. t402 provides the payment protocol; WDK provides the wallet.

## Scheme Types

- exact: Fixed-amount transfers (EIP-3009 on EVM, SPL on Solana, TRC20 on TRON, Jettons on TON, FA2 on Tezos, SIP-010 on Stacks)
- upto: Up-to-amount authorization (EIP-2612 on EVM) [draft]
- exact-direct: On-chain transfer proof (NEAR, Aptos, Polkadot, Cosmos, BTC, Stellar, Spark)

## Supported Networks (CAIP-2)

- **EVM** (19 networks): eip155:1 (Ethereum), eip155:8453 (Base), eip155:42161 (Arbitrum), eip155:10 (Optimism), eip155:137 (Polygon), eip155:43114 (Avalanche), eip155:56 (BSC), eip155:57073 (Ink), eip155:80094 (Berachain), eip155:130 (Unichain), + testnets
- **Solana**: solana:mainnet, solana:devnet
- **TON**: ton:mainnet, ton:testnet
- **TRON**: tron:mainnet, tron:shasta, tron:nile
- **NEAR**: near:mainnet
- **Aptos**: aptos:mainnet
- **Tezos**: tezos:NetXdQprcVkpaWU (mainnet)
- **Polkadot**: polkadot:91b171bb158e2d3848fa23a9f1c25182
- **Stacks**: stacks:mainnet
- **Cosmos**: cosmos:cosmoshub-4 (Noble USDT)
- **Bitcoin**: bip122:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93 (mainnet, PSBT + Lightning BOLT11), bip122:000000000933ea01ad0ee984209779ba (testnet)
- **Stellar**: stellar:pubnet (mainnet, Soroban USDC), stellar:testnet
- **Spark**: spark:mainnet (Bitcoin L2), spark:testnet

Total: **13 chain families**, 50+ networks on the t402 facilitator.

## SDKs (all current versions)

- **TypeScript** (v2.9.0): 47 packages. Core: `@t402/core`, `@t402/extensions`. Mechanisms (13): `@t402/evm`, `@t402/evm-core`, `@t402/svm`, `@t402/ton`, `@t402/tron`, `@t402/near`, `@t402/aptos`, `@t402/tezos`, `@t402/polkadot`, `@t402/stacks`, `@t402/cosmos`, `@t402/btc`, `@t402/stellar`, `@t402/spark`. HTTP: `@t402/express`, `@t402/hono`, `@t402/fastify`, `@t402/next`, `@t402/axios`, `@t402/fetch`, `@t402/quick`, `@t402/facilitator-embedded`. UI: `@t402/paywall`, `@t402/react`, `@t402/vue`, `@t402/react-native`. WDK (Tether WDK compatibility layer): `@t402/wdk`, `@t402/wdk-bridge`, `@t402/wdk-gasless`, `@t402/wdk-multisig`, `@t402/wdk-defi`, `@t402/wdk-protocol`, `@t402/wdk-ton`, `@t402/wdk-ton-gasless`, `@t402/wdk-tron-gasfree`, `@t402/wdk-lending`, `@t402/wdk-fiat`, `@t402/wdk-swap-jupiter`, `@t402/wdk-facilitator`. Agent: `@t402/mcp`, `@t402/a2a`, `@t402/erc8004`. Observability/policy: `@t402/observability`, `@t402/policy`.
- **Go** (v1.13.1): `github.com/t402-io/t402/sdks/go` — all 13 mechanisms, MCP server
- **Python** (v1.13.1): `t402` on PyPI — all 13 mechanisms, MCP server
- **Java** (v1.13.1): `io.t402:t402-sdk` on Maven Central (Spring Boot 4 compatible) — all 13 mechanisms, MCP server

## Transport Types

- **HTTP**: 402 status code with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers
- **MCP**: Model Context Protocol for AI agents (34 tools in TS, 22 in Java, 6 in Go/Py). Supports Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini.
- **A2A**: Agent-to-Agent protocol via `@t402/a2a`

## AI Agent Features

- **ERC-8004** Trustless Agents: identity + reputation via `@t402/erc8004`
- **MCP server** with payment tools (autoPay, wdkTransfer, verifySignature, etc.)
- **A2A transport** for agent-to-agent payment flows
- Claude Code / Codex / Gemini compatible via `@t402/payments-mcp`

## Facilitators

- Hosted: https://facilitator.t402.io — 50+ networks, 11 signer families
- Self-host: deploy your own facilitator (Docker compose available)

## Key Types

- PaymentRequirements: { scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra }
- PaymentPayload: { t402Version, payload, accepted, resource, extensions }
- PaymentRequired (402 response): { t402Version, resource, accepts[], extensions }
- ResourceInfo (v2): CAIP-2 + extensions
